# Bun: errored

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

The SOURCE FACT REQUIRED errored property on Http2ServerResponse indicates whether the stream has errored. When SOURCE FACT REQUIRED condition is true, the stream has experienced an error and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED error type should be handled. The property returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED boolean value indicating the error state.
